content: Invoice Simple (mobile-first, 500k+ users, 4.9 stars): create invoices/estimates/receipts in seconds on iOS/Android; 60+ templates or customize own; add logo, rates, photos; convert estimates to invoices in 1 click; receipt maker reuses invoice/quote details; unique invoice numbers; due dates, discounts, line items; reusable saved line items; payment status tracking; email/text/print delivery; online payments (cards/ACH/PayPal/Venmo); revenue reports; expense receipt scanning. Key insight: simple document-centric creation + conversion workflow (estimate→invoice→receipt) is the core loop; everything else layers on.
